title: Matcher: Segment Anything with One Shot Using All-Purpose Feature Matching
mechanism: DINOv2 patch matching gives point prompts; SAM generates and filters masks; training-free one-shot.
evidence: R: 52.7 mIoU COCO-20i 1-shot; GFDS measured only 5.0 mIoU on industrial defects.
adaptation: Benchmark row only (K-shot track), 3-channel replicated EL, 1024 px.
min_experiment: K-shot track row vs SAM2 video mode; no labeller run unless it beats 0.2 inactive IoU on H36.
